en: Fixed `--worktree` sessions sometimes starting from the wrong commit when a tag or branch was named like a commit ID, and their starting git status naming a branch other than the new worktree's
zh: 修复了 tag 或分支名与 commit ID 相似时，`--worktree` session 有时从错误的 commit 启动的问题，以及其启动时的 git 状态显示的分支不是新 worktree 的分支的问题
